title: Technical debt: recording it, negotiating it and paying it down

videos.script: The code is a mess and we need time to clean it up. Said like that, the request almost always loses. {{mess}} Here is the same request, translated. The test suite costs us twenty-five hours every sprint. Fixing it takes sixty. It pays for itself in under three sprints. {{translated}} That second version is how technical debt was meant to be talked about. A principal, what it costs to fix. And interest, what it costs every week you do not. {{debt}} This lesson separates debt from defects and preferences, records it where the product owner will see it, and puts a number on the interest. {{record}} Then it shows how to negotiate time to pay it, which ways of paying actually work, and when the right answer is to leave a debt exactly where it is. {{pay}}
